facts.fact: Livvie 敲 Tamsin 的房门没人应声，只换来一句“别烦我”。
facts.anchor: my tentative knock was met with silence

facts.fact: Livvie 打开 Kelville 的房间，里面陈设一如他来之前，仿佛他从未住过。
facts.anchor: Kelville might never have been there

facts.fact: Simon 收拾行李时把消息补全：Llayson 不打算续租，他儿子要带全家搬进来，父亲还指望《Tempest》长久演下去。
facts.anchor: Llayson intends not to renew the lease

facts.fact: Mrs. Fletcher 压低声音告诉 Livvie：警员 Lundy 为 Kelville 先生的事找 Lily 谈过话，Lily 也很乐意把 Livvie、尤其是 Tamsin 的事讲给他听。
facts.anchor: That constable Lundy spoke to Lily

facts.fact: 被追问时，Livvie 咬定出事那晚 Tamsin 和自己在一起。
facts.anchor: she was with me that night

facts.fact: Mrs. Fletcher 自言自语说不知道那姑娘出了什么事：Anna Eudy 心最善、脑最灵，可两样缺一样呢？
facts.anchor: I don’t know what happened to that girl

facts.fact: 临别她把话锋对准 Livvie：你占了两样还不够，还多一样美貌——而美貌连奶酪都不如耐放。
facts.anchor: Beauty. There’s cheese lasts longer than that

facts.fact: Simon 在走廊喊车已备好，Livvie 收好画具行李，与 Tamsin 一同出发。
